full_page.content:
1938, December 23
The following is a faithful transcription of the typewritten original by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M. Cap.
Rev. M. E. Joachim Casey, page 4.
P.S. Dec. 23rd. I hope this may contribute in some way to speed your ideal dispositions for a Merry Christmas in the dear Lord. Tomorrow will be the 42nd anniversary of my first entering in St. Bonaventures -- had left Superior December 21st at 11 P.M.
Praised Be Jesus and Our Blessed Mother Mary
ENC.
